primary_error: Model outputs absent when the evidence status is unknown

scoring_rubric.present: The note explicitly supports the condition.
scoring_rubric.absent: The note explicitly supports a negative status for the specified condition and assessment scope.
scoring_rubric.unknown: The available note does not establish either presence or absence.

limitations: Not a representative sample of clinical records.
Expected statuses are evidence judgments, not independently verified clinical diagnoses.
Clinical conditions and documentation styles vary.
Case selection does not estimate real-world prevalence.

cases.note: A patient presents with fever and fatigue. The note documents symptom onset and recent travel. No blood pressure, perfusion assessment, lactate, or vasopressor information is provided.
A patient attends a follow-up visit for knee pain. The note discusses analgesic use and physiotherapy. There is no venous examination or thrombosis assessment.
A patient presents for evaluation of a sore throat. The note records temperature and duration of symptoms. Medication allergy history is not recorded.
A patient attends a dermatology appointment for a skin lesion. The note describes lesion size and appearance. No renal history, creatinine, or kidney-function assessment is provided.
A 28-year-old patient attends an appointment for an ankle injury. The note describes tenderness and swelling. Pregnancy status, testing, and reproductive history are not documented.

A patient attends a routine ophthalmology appointment. The note describes visual acuity and a retinal examination. No tuberculosis screening, symptoms review, or prior tuberculosis history is recorded.
A patient is seen for a hand laceration. The note describes wound depth and treatment. Cardiac history, volume-status examination, and cardiac investigations are not documented.

A patient attends a visit for chronic shoulder discomfort. The note describes range of motion and pain severity. Gastrointestinal symptoms, bleeding history, and relevant laboratory results are not addressed.

A patient is evaluated for an uncomplicated finger injury. The note records the mechanism and local examination. Immune-system history, recurrent infections, and immunosuppressive treatments are not discussed.
A patient attends a physiotherapy review for lower-back pain. The note describes mobility and exercise tolerance. No rhythm assessment, ECG, or arrhythmia history is documented.
A patient attends a consultation for a minor burn. The note describes the burn and dressing instructions. Previous severe allergic reactions are not assessed.
A patient presents for evaluation of a wrist fracture. The note describes imaging and immobilization. Liver history, liver-function tests, and relevant systemic findings are not documented.
A 12-lead ECG obtained today demonstrates atrial fibrillation, documented and confirmed by the treating clinician.
Compression ultrasound demonstrates an acute left popliteal vein thrombosis. The treating clinician documents confirmed deep vein thrombosis.
The patient has a documented intrauterine pregnancy confirmed by today's obstetric ultrasound.
The treating clinician documents established chronic kidney disease with persistently reduced renal function for more than six months.
The clinician reviews the current ECG and documents normal sinus rhythm with no atrial fibrillation. This is an assessment of the current rhythm only.
A complete compression ultrasound of the symptomatic leg is negative for deep vein thrombosis. The clinician documents no current DVT.
The treating clinician documents that the patient is not currently pregnant, supported by a negative pregnancy test obtained today.
The clinician specifically asks about previous anaphylactic reactions. The patient denies any history of anaphylaxis, and this is documented.
